name: Materials (FreeCAD data)
about: 138 real materials from FreeCAD's open material library (CC-BY): density, strength, stiffness, heat — plus CNC cutting speeds for 13 machining materials, turned into starting RPM and feed for your end mill.
description: Looks up real material properties (density, yield / tensile strength, Young's modulus, thermal data) for metals, plastics (PLA, ABS, PET, acrylic...), woods, glass; and CNC starting values (spindle RPM, feed, chip load) for a tool diameter. Use it for 'how strong / heavy is ...', material choice, and CNC feeds and speeds.
instructions: Fill in: query = the material in plain words (e.g. "aluminum 6061", "PLA", "MDF", "stainless steel", "oak hard wood"). For CNC milling / routing also give tool_diameter (mm), flutes (2 if not said) and max_rpm of the machine if the user said it (24000 for a router, 12000 for many hobby spindles). Answer with the JSON only.
